body: Worker rule (Termal::BarA1, from Fable2 #131, 2026-10-10): when a claim lapses and is recovered under a new claim fence, RE-NAME the item's source root with termal_name_source_root under the current claim (at the item's next carry, before its gate), and confirm the NEW generation in the following turn. Confirming the old generation is not enough: an evaluation can be refused 409 on a naming made under the prior claim fence (the w-cd57 trap).
